summary: Husband and son overdue from a hike on the Blue Lake Trail; wife and daughter, camping at Chambers Lake Campground, called dispatch in the evening. SAR responded to the trailhead and the campsite; all family members were found at the campsite, OK, and the mission was stood down.
location: Blue Lake Trail / Chambers Lake Campground
notes: Mission date 6/29/19 per the mission report. Distinct from id 3476 (2019-06-30, Blue Lakes near North Peak/Greenhorn, Wet Mountains).
